cand.title: 2027 Dream It Incentive Trip
cand.excerpt: Ranked on evidence strength, hospitality mechanism, Punta Cana fit and accessibility; no unsupported attendance or room-night assumptions.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Shandi Evans, Sr. Manager of Events and Recognition at New U Life, is the strongest operational contact candidate. Ken Shoell is identified on the official leadership page as VP of Sales, with prior leadership of events, sales programmes and incentives; a professional profile also lists General Manager of Japan, so confirm his current geographic remit. Neither source proves either person signs hotel contracts or specifically controls the 2027 trip.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed announced upcoming edition within the requested horizon: Punta Cana, Dominican Republic, June 2027. Exact start/end days are unverified. Qualification runs October 17, 2026–March 19, 2027; these are NOT travel dates. The events index displays May 31, 2027, conflicting with the dedicated page’s June travel month; do not publish that listing date as arrival.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: the 620-room Uvero Alto all-inclusive is geographically aligned with the announced Punta Cana destination and conceptually fits a room-led beach incentive with recognition meals and leisure activities. Prior Secrets resort trips support resort-format relevance, not Wyndham selection. Approximately 380 m² of meeting space and supplied capacities of roughly 300 conference/200 banquet make fit conditional on the largest function, not room count alone. No attendance or room-night estimate is supportable.
findings.venueCommitments: No named 2027 hotel or meeting venue was identified in the official trip page or targeted public research. Commitment status is unknown, not open. No evidence establishes a booking at Wyndham Alltra or at a competitor.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented editions move across destinations: Maui (June 2022), Costa Rica (May 2023; Secrets Papagayo All-Inclusive Resort), Jamaica (June 9–13, 2024; Secrets Wild Orchid All-Inclusive Resort), Puerto Vallarta (September 2025), and a 2026 Caribbean Cruise listing. The 2026 detail page mixes cruise copy with 2027 Punta Cana qualification/travel text and is unreliable for precise 2026 dates. This verifies repeated programmes and destination rotation, not a fixed annual schedule or a future tender.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Organizer-administered award/registration pathway: qualifying winners receive an emailed registration link after announcement; winners are to be announced no later than April 2027. The prize includes a trip for one in a shared room or for two; each room permits two adults. Participants arrange their own PUJ flights. New U Life states it incurs costs when attendees register. Inference: approach the corporate events function rather than individual distributors for accommodation sourcing. No public hotel RFP, named purchasing agency, block or open bid process was found.
findings.organizationStructure: New U Life is the corporate owner/operator of a distributor sales incentive, not an association event. Official rules link qualification to product sales, subscriptions and distributor performance. Internal events/recognition and sales roles are evidenced. No separate PCO, DMC or travel agency was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Prior Secrets Papagayo and Secrets Wild Orchid stays are historical competing-resort relationships, not a 2027 incumbent commitment or open inventory. No sourced overflow, displacement, capacity shortfall or competitor sell-out was found. No evidence places this trip in Cap Cana, La Romana or Bayahibe; do not transfer demand from those alternatives to Uvero Alto.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Shandi Evans first to establish whether June 2027 rooms are signed and who handles sourcing. Ask Ken Shoell for an internal introduction if needed, while confirming his remit. If unplaced, request exact dates, nights, peak rooms, budget, rooming mix and function requirements before offering a tailored Alltra incentive proposal. If committed, do not pitch assumed overflow: seek the next uncontracted cycle’s brief and decision calendar. Final qualification remains with ORS.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 is announced but hotel-sales accessibility is unconfirmed. Participant access is restricted to qualifiers and eligible plus-ones; non-qualifiers cannot buy into planned activities. That restriction is separate from supplier procurement and does not establish whether hotel sourcing is open or closed.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: multiple prior destinations and all-inclusive resort precedents justify an account-level relationship for a future uncontracted beach incentive. No later edition, destination, dates or open competition is confirmed. The programme rules expressly allow discontinuation without notice; do not label 2028 demand as expected or confirmed.
